_why: Class-feature records a SUBCLASS hands over, which are in no class's `features` list and are not subclass options themselves — so ownedFeatureIds had no route to them and every field and star on them rendered for nobody. Merged onto the subclass option by scripts/import-core-v2.mjs.
_source: Each oracle mystery's own AoN entry names its curse under a `right="Oracular Curse"` heading. Extracted from the local mirror at C:/wonderers guide/aon-2e-archive/data/by-category/mystery/. NOT inferred from the ids: the curse text is actively misleading — Curse of Inevitable Rot says "time" and belongs to BLIGHT. Where AoN lists both a legacy and a remaster curse for a mystery, the remaster one is used, matching what this app ships: Battle takes Curse of the Mortal Warrior (not the Hero's Burden) and Tempest takes Curse of Inclement Headwinds (not the Perpetual Storm).
